newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Electronic payment for shares offered in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Electronic payment for shares offered in Singapore.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) said on Wednesday it has launched electronic payment for share (EPS) transactions.
With EPS, an investor can electronically transfer funds from his bank account to his stockbroking company to pay for share purchases, SES said in a statement.
The investor can also request for sale proceeds to be deposited directly into his bank after he has sold his shares.
Through EPS, the broker will receive payment on the market day after payment has been initiated.
SES said all stockbroking companies, except international members and G K Goh Stockbrokers, will have the EPS system available to their clients.
